name: sqlwayfarer
description: A SQL Server & Azure SQL workspace for VS Code: see what depends on a column, trace the tables a procedure really touches through triggers, edit and run T-SQL across multiple files with execution plans, generate scripts, and export a Markdown data dictionary.

sqlwayfarer.openLastConnection.description: The Open SQL Wayfarer command opens the last connection used straight away, instead of asking which one.

sqlwayfarer.diagnostics.syntax.markdownDescription: Underline T-SQL syntax errors in the query editor. SQL Server itself parses the text (`SET PARSEONLY ON`, on a connection of its own): nothing is run and the names of tables and columns are not checked. Off by default.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.enabled.description: Turn the query editor's autocompletion on or off.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.autoTrigger.description: Open the suggestions while typing. When off, they only open with Ctrl+Space.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.triggerAfterKey.description: Open the suggestions right after FROM, JOIN, INTO, UPDATE, EXEC and USE, before any letter is typed.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.minChars.description: Letters to type before the suggestions open by themselves.

enumDescriptions: Names that start with what you typed.
Also initials (ho -> HumanOrders) and scattered letters. Best matches first.
sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.matching.description: How what you typed is matched against names.

enumDescriptions: Follow what you typed: lowercase if you typed lowercase, uppercase otherwise.
sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.keywordCase.description: Case of the keywords and functions inserted.

enumDescriptions: Tab and Enter accept the suggestion.
Only Tab accepts; Enter always adds a new line.
sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.acceptKeys.description: Keys that accept the selected suggestion.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.showTypes.description: Show the data type next to the column suggestions.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.addAlias.description: After FROM or JOIN, insert a short alias with the table name (HumanOrders -> HumanOrders ho).

enumDescriptions: [Brackets] only around names that need them (spaces, reserved words).
sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.bracketNames.description: When inserted names are put between square brackets.

enumDescriptions: alias.Column only when several tables have that column.
sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.columnQualifica.description: Whether suggested columns are prefixed with their table alias.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.includeSystemOb.description: Include sys and INFORMATION_SCHEMA objects in the suggestions.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.sortByUsage.description: Offer first what you picked before in this session, among equally good matches.

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.snippets.description: Suggest snippets (type its abbreviation, e.g. ssf, then Tab).

sqlwayfarer.autocomplete.showDetails.description: Show a details line under the suggestions (full type, nullability, primary key, foreign key...).

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:helper && vsce package
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run build:helper && vsce publish
scripts.test:unit: mocha --ui tdd "test/*.test.js" --ignore test/extension.test.js --ignore test/panelState.test.js --ignore test/queryFileHandlers.test.js --ignore test/queryHandlers.test.js --ignore test/indexHandlers.test.js --ignore test/liveQueryHandlers.test.js --ignore test/ratingPrompt.test.js --ignore test/snippetHandlers.test.js
